title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16

ai_review.summary: A crisp (though slightly hissy) soundboard capture of the legendary Janis Joplin & Dead show, highlighted by an electrifying Lovelight jam.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers surprisingly clear audio for a tape‑sourced soundboard capture, with only modest hiss that doesn’t detract from the overall listening experience. The performance itself is celebrated as one of the most memorable Janis‑and‑Dead moments, especially the scorching Lovelight interaction with Pigpen and Jerry’s “sexy” guitar work, plus strong early cuts like Candyman and China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic 4‑5 star reviews praise both the musical performance and the sound quality; weighting 70% show (≈5) and 30% recording (≈4) yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note a crisp mix with noticeable tape hiss; one reviewer mentions a direct cassette transfer, but overall the audio is clear and enjoyable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early Candyman leads into the classic China/Rider segue, followed by the highlight Lovelight jam with Janis, Pigpen and Jerry; an NRPS set with additional Janis‑Pigpen duets is also mentioned.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is described as "sexy" and a key element of the Lovelight interplay with Janis.
